audit.say: Starting a scan of the demo hotel website.
Opening the hotel's guest-upload page and listing every file on it.
Looking inside each image for ID cards and thumbprints.
Found an ID card that anyone on the internet can open.
Found a second exposed ID photo on the check-in page.
Found a third exposed copy in the guest register PDF.
Your turn: to lock your biometrics, enter the OTP that UIDAI sends to your phone. We never see it.
Checking each find against the rules. Anything unclear is sent to a person.
Writing a takedown notice you can send to the website owner.
All done. 3 exposed copies found and a takedown notice is ready.

result.notice:
# Takedown notice (draft)

To: The owner of the demo hotel website

Subject: Please remove exposed identity documents

Three identity documents belonging to guests can be opened by anyone on your website:

1. /uploads/kyc_101.jpg
2. /uploads/kyc_102.jpg
3. /register/guests.pdf

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you must protect personal data you hold. Please take these files down within 24 hours and confirm in writing.

This is a draft. Please read it before sending. It is not legal advice.

forgery.say: Looking at the copy that was edited.
Part of the picture was changed after the copy was sealed. The marked area covers the photo, so this copy should not be trusted.
The copy was edited, so it fails the check. Ask the owner for a fresh copy.

result.summary: The photo area was swapped after sealing. Do not accept this copy.
